Title: Malkavian Madness Network and Meddling of Semsith

Messages.Author: vermillian
Messages.Body:
Just to make sure I've got this right...

Meddling restricts my card redrawing for all methuselahs minion
phases...

When do my malkavians get to take their extra actions, anyhow? During
the END of another methuselah's minion phase, or just after he's done
taking minion phase actions (but not quite the END of his minion
phase).

Interpretting it in the latter case, as the card reads, a meth. with
madness acting malkavians still wouldn't get his redraws, would he?

A side note: With a meddling in play, I could be a crazy guy and
feline sabatour my prey for like, seven and deny him a hand for the
rest of my minion phase! Or, or... like play revelations and he
couldn't redraw! (actually, the second part IS pretty sweet, cause now
you KNOW what he has in his hand, and he isn't redrawing a better
card, or a replacement for that wake you made him drop).

~SV

Messages.Author: GreySeer
Messages.Body:
"vermillian" <vermil...@yahoo.com> wrote in message
news:f987c6cd.02042...@posting.google.com...


Name: Madness Network
[Jyhad, V:TES]
Cardtype: Master
Clan: Malkavian
Unique Master.
Put this card in play. After another Methuselah has finished all of his or
her minion phase actions, any untapped Malkavian can take an action (go
clockwise if two or more attempt to take actions). Any minion can burn this
card as an action that any untapped Malkavian {(in addition to the normally
eligible blockers)} can attempt to block (go clockwise if two or more
attempt to block).

Although it doesn't specifically say so, I'd take it that you may only take
your actions during someone else's minion phase after they've completed all
their actions. This is how I have and have seen it played. This being the
case, you are correct, the target Meth does not replace while you take your
actions.
